correctness.rationale: Exact integrator sampling gives a companion matrix with trace \(1-a-b\) and determinant \(ab\). The real quadratic Jury test gives \(ab<1\) and \(ab>a+b-2\), with all boundaries strict. The interval-product range \((0,m^2]\) gives the complete mean classification; the universal spectral trace lower bound has equality only at a repeated negative eigenvalue, giving the unique positive optimizing pair. The proof covers all reals; 2,809 symbolic/rational/numerical assertions independently replay the identities and examples.

A related 2022 full text could not be inspected, leaving a substantive residual precedence risk.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact-parameter solution of a motivated control-scheduling problem with one delayed measurement, a necessary-and-sufficient stability region, a strict 50-percent extension of feasible average sampling period over constant spacing, and a unique optimal two-interval spectral rate. The result characterizes both excessive balance and excessive imbalance and does not assert arbitrary-schedule robustness or finite-time norm optimality.
